roots.name: 软件开发与维护 / Software engineering
roots.description: Design, plan, implement, debug, test or review software and its application security. 软件方案、编程、测试、代码与依赖审查。 Retrieving documentation alone belongs to information; operating deployed systems belongs to operations.

children.name: 软件方案与实现计划 / Software design and planning
children.description: Translate software requirements into architecture, implementation steps, API/data/error behavior and engineering plans. Includes design guidance; distinguishes business planning and listing existing work tickets.

children.name: 实现、调试与测试 / Implementation, debugging and testing
children.description: Implement or repair frontend/backend/app code, debug failures, test first, refactor and verify software behavior. 指导与执行均可；documentation lookup alone is a different purpose.

children.name: 代码、依赖与应用安全 / Code, dependency and application security review
children.description: Review code quality, dependencies, vulnerabilities and software authentication/authorization design. Includes access-control design guidance; running account administration is a different operation.

roots.name: 资料检索与研究 / Information and research
roots.description: Find or read existing information, evidence, publications and technical documentation. 搜索资料与核对来源。 Writing original content, implementing code and clicking through browser workflows have separate purposes.

children.name: 论文与学术证据 / Scholarly search
children.description: Discover research papers, scientific publications, citations and scholarly evidence. Existing literature retrieval; distinguishes original promotional writing and general browser operation.

children.name: 网页与通用知识 / Web information and knowledge
children.description: Search/read web pages, factual knowledge, reference material and public information sources. Reading existing information; interactive UI workflows and specialized SDK documentation are separately identified.

children.name: 开发文档与 API 资料 / Developer documentation
children.description: Retrieve framework, library, API and SDK documentation, versions and examples. 获取开发资料；this alone does not assert implementation, debugging or code-review support.

roots.name: 写作、传播与语言 / Writing, communication and language
roots.description: Plan, draft, edit, translate or adapt original textual communication for an audience. 写稿、内容规划、营销和本地化。 Retrieving existing sources and sending through an account are separate functions.

children.name: 文章与搜索内容 / Articles and search-oriented content
children.description: Plan/write/edit articles, tutorials and other long-form content, including reader intent, SEO content structure and headings. Content creation; distinguishes only fetching search results or keyword data.

children.name: 文案、翻译与本地化 / Copy, translation and localization
children.description: Draft or adapt messages, copy and multilingual text, tone and audience wording. Textual guidance or production; no account sending or software translation features are inferred.

children.name: 营销与商业表达 / Marketing and business communication
children.description: Prepare marketing campaigns, product/brand messaging and business communications for audiences. Creative or strategic communication; financial calculations and account transactions have separate purposes.

roots.name: 计算、数据与财务 / Computation, data and finance
roots.description: Calculate quantities, convert units/times, analyze data or evaluate financial conditions. 数值换算、统计分析、经营数字与风险。 Formatting output files or changing account balances is a separate operation.

children.name: 计算与换算 / Calculation and conversion
children.description: Compute mathematical results and convert units, dates or time zones, including date-aware daylight-saving rules when explicitly supported. 时间换算；calendar event creation and invitation sending are separate.

children.name: 财务评估与情景分析 / Financial evaluation and scenarios
children.description: Analyze financial statements, cash, costs, runway, forecasts, scenarios and financial risks. Includes analytical guidance; no real accounts, billing actions or missing financial features are implied.

children.name: 数据与统计分析 / Data and statistical analysis
children.description: Process/explore datasets, query analytical data, derive statistics and interpret charts or tables. Data analysis purpose; spreadsheet/document formatting and generic database connection are separately identified.

roots.name: 办公产物与日程沟通 / Office artifacts and coordination
roots.description: Create or manipulate documents, spreadsheets, presentations, calendars, messages and work records. 办公文件、日程与协作。 Keep artifact/account operations distinct from analyzing their subject matter or merely drafting text.

children.name: 文档、表格与 PDF / Documents, spreadsheets and PDF
children.description: Create/edit/format or transform document, spreadsheet and PDF artifacts, including supported spreadsheet formulas. 文件操作与排版；do not infer financial analysis merely from spreadsheet access.

children.name: 演示文稿 / Presentations
children.description: Create/edit slides, presentation layouts and supported speaker notes. 演示产物；this purpose differs from producing the underlying research or numerical analysis.

children.name: 日历、消息与任务 / Calendars, messages and tasks
children.description: Read or manage calendars, agendas, events, messages, invitations and task records, according to explicit supported actions. 区分查看与写入；time-zone arithmetic and drafting prose alone are separate functions.

roots.name: 视觉与音视频 / Visual and audiovisual media
roots.description: Design, create, edit or transform visual, audio and video media. 设计、图像、音频与视频。 Software UI implementation belongs to engineering, while making its visual design belongs here.

children.name: 视觉设计与图像 / Visual design and images
children.description: Create/edit graphic design, UI visuals, images, illustrations, layouts and visual assets. Design guidance or execution; converting a design into working software is separately identified.

children.name: 音频与视频 / Audio and video
children.description: Create/edit/transcribe or transform audio, speech, music and video assets when stated in metadata. 媒体处理；do not infer content publishing, account access or unsupported generation features.

roots.name: 系统、浏览器与服务操作 / Systems, browsers and service operations
roots.description: Operate software environments, files, networks, browser interfaces and service connections. 系统环境与应用操作。 Prefer a service's explicit user-facing purpose when known; generic connectivity does not prove all downstream capabilities.

children.name: 浏览器交互 / Browser interaction
children.description: Navigate, click, enter data and inspect actual web-interface behavior with browser automation. 真实页面操作；fetching/searching information alone is separately identified.

children.name: 系统、文件与部署 / Systems, files and deployment
children.description: Operate local/remote files, shells, runtime environments, infrastructure, networks, deployments and services. 运维与环境操作；application logic design or implementation has a separate purpose.

children.name: 通用应用与服务连接 / General application and service connections
children.description: Connect/access external applications, APIs and databases where only general integration is described. Preserve limitations; do not turn a generic connector into every possible domain capability.

roots.name: 专业领域与互动体验 / Specialized domains and interactive experiences
roots.description: Apply domain-specific expertise or provide entertainment/interactive experiences outside the named general-purpose operations. 行业、文化、教育及互动用途；specific retrieval, writing or computation remains classifiable by its operation.

children.name: 专业指导与学习 / Domain guidance and learning
children.description: Provide specialized professional, cultural, educational or domain reasoning guidance not covered by the general-purpose functions. Do not infer professional qualifications or execution authority.

children.name: 游戏与互动体验 / Games and interactive experiences
children.description: Provide games, simulations, characters, role-play and interactive entertainment experiences. 使用互动体验；developing the underlying application is a software-engineering purpose.
